Chachamaru"Major General Willow?"
常闇斎"Unknown. Possibly already eliminated."
Chachamaru"What happened?"
常闇斎"Before dawn last night... today, strictly speaking. Deputy Secretary-General Count Ruby Sarchant entered the country secretly, visited the field headquarters in Kamakura, and apparently made some disposition."
常闇斎"Since then, Willow’s whereabouts unknown. Cannon and Professor Wolf confined separately."
常闇斎"As UN plenipotentiary and accredited ambassador of the Commonwealth Queen, Count Sarchant appears effectively to be taking command."
Chachamaru"..."
Kageaki"...Chachamaru, explain."
Chachamaru"Found out..."
Chachamaru"Cannon, who directed GHQ’s Yamato policy, was a New Continent separatist. Wanted Yamato for independence. Wanted the bomb to take Yamato."
Chachamaru"The Green Dragon SocietyWe—Wolf, rather—intended to assist the separatists while using them..."
Kageaki"...At this last moment, the UN discovered Cannon’s faction?"
Chachamaru"Only explanation."
常闇斎"Yes."

en.html:
I see. A dubious group like the Green Dragon Society could interfere with a great military administration because it had found a suitable opening.

The <ruby>New Continent<rt>Neo Britain</rt></ruby> separatists—<ruby>the dreamers<rt>American Dreamers</rt></ruby>. If Russia was the Commonwealth’s open great enemy, they were its latent one. Four major uprisings; smaller rebellions beyond counting.

If the occupation forces’ dominant faction secretly opposed the Commonwealth, accepting an ally with ulterior motives like Wolf made sense. Any useful ally would be welcome.

A skillful <ruby>parasitism<rt>・・</rt></ruby>. But now the host was dying—

成程。
　進駐軍のような強大な軍政組織に緑龍会などという
怪しげな集団が干渉できたのは、相応の付け入る隙が
あったからか。

　<ruby>新大陸<rt>ネオブリテン</rt></ruby>独立派――<ruby>夢見る人々<rt>アメリカンドリーマーズ</rt></ruby>。大英連邦の表の大敵
がロシア帝国なら、潜在的な大敵は彼らだと云える。
　大規模な一斉蜂起は過去に四度。中小規模の反乱は
幾度あったか、数え切れない。

　進駐軍の中心派閥がその独立派で、密かに大英連邦
を敵視していたのなら、ウォルフ教授のような底意の
ある協力者を受け入れたのも納得はいく。
　役立つ味方はいくらでも欲しい心境であったろう。

　上手く<ruby>寄生<rt>・・</rt></ruby>したものだ。
　しかしそれも、宿主が枯死しかけている今となって
は――

en.html:
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"...Damn it..."
Chachamaru"KYA YAAR! One conspiracy! Apun is asking for ONE properly functioning conspiracy! Why does every bloody cog have its own secret plan!?"
Kageaki"Because they are conspiracies, presumably."
Chachamaru"At this rate, no bomb. The UN visitor wants GHQ sorted before doing anything to Yamato..."
常闇斎"..."
Kageaki"Chachamaru. Is Cannon a capable・・・ man?"
Chachamaru"Eh?"
Kageaki"Set him free, and could he recover his position even now?"
Chachamaru"Hmm... yes. Tough, clever."
Chachamaru"Retake command and continue the operation, perhaps. The plenipotentiary apparently has not publicly branded him a rebel yet..."
常闇斎"Yes, that is the account. But Minato sir... what would you do?"
Kageaki"If rescuing him repairs matters, rescue him."
Kageaki"I shall go now."
Chachamaru"You!?"
Kageaki"Who else?"
Chachamaru"No, but... no. Dangerous."
Kageaki"An odd objection on a battlefield."
Chachamaru"Degrees exist! Nothing as dangerous as last time!"
Kageaki"Last time? Kenchouji?"
Chachamaru"My mistake, that one. Did not think the black fellow was an armored warrior... Ah, want to beat sense into the apun who sent you at him!"
Chachamaru"Remembering still kills the appetite!"

　全権代理って奴もまだおおっぴらに中佐を
反逆者扱いはしていないっぽいし……」



常闇斎
「ええ、そういう話です。
　しかし湊斗様……ならどうすると仰せられ
ますか？」



景明
「その男を救えば何とかなるなら、救うまで」



景明
「これから行ってくる」



茶々丸
「お兄さんが!?」



景明
「他に誰がいる」



茶々丸
「いや、でも……
　だめだよ、危ないよ」



景明
「戦場で云う台詞とも思えんが」



茶々丸
「程度ってもんがあるし。
　こないだみたいに危険なのはやだからね！」



景明
「この間？
　建朝寺の時の話か」



茶々丸
「あれはあてのミスだったけど。
　まさかあのまっくろ太郎が武者とは思わな
かったから……あー、あんなのにお兄さんを
けしかけたあの時の自分をどつき倒したい！」



茶々丸
「いま思い出しても食欲が減退するわ！」

en.html:
Kageaki"...I swept him aside."
Chachamaru"Result, yes. But occupation headquarters will have more than one or two dragoons. Definitely."
Kageaki"I shall manage."
Chachamaru"If ‘shall manage’ managed everything, our country would not have lost six years ago!"
Kageaki"What is this? You trust me so little?"
Chachamaru"N-no, not that. But..."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Glaring does not make this yes! N-n-not scared!"
Chachamaru"Hmph!"
Kageaki"Very well. Your permission is immaterial."
Kageaki"I shall go."
Chachamaru"NO!"

Kageaki"Release my sash."
常闇斎"Lieutenant General... people are beginning to notice."
Chachamaru"No means no means no! If you insist—"
Kageaki"What?"
Chachamaru"Apun comes also!"
Kageaki"Are you an idiot?"
Chachamaru"Cannot compete with you!"
Kageaki"A general abandoning her position?"
Chachamaru"You are the deputy!"
Kageaki"Then I can resign."
Chachamaru"Abandoning apun!?"
Kageaki"Not the subject. Even if it were, I see no particular reason to hesitate."
Chachamaru"Wah! Horrible man!"
常闇斎"Minato sir. Lieutenant General."

en.html:
Kageaki"Your turn now?"
Chachamaru"Ugh..."
常闇斎"Please leave this to me."
Chachamaru"...Jouan?"
常闇斎"That was my intention from the beginning."
Kageaki"You are scarcely idle either."
常闇斎"Many can perform my duties in my place."
Kageaki"The same applies to me. Less trouble if I go."
常闇斎"But the right person for the right task. You are not an infiltration specialist."
Kageaki"..."
常闇斎"This Jouan leads the Yagyuu clan, the Ashikaga house’s hidden hands. Entering enemy positions is ordinary daily business."
Chachamaru"Jouan... will you?"
常闇斎"For the Green Dragon Society. For my faith."
常闇斎"I shall meet your expectations."
Chachamaru"Yes..."
Kageaki"..."
常闇斎"Minato sir. As the lieutenant general so aptly observed, schemes do not readily proceed as intended."
常闇斎"Further unexpected developments may arise. Remain beside her, prepare for them."
常闇斎"Jouan humbly requests it."
Kageaki"...Understood."
Kageaki"Jouansai Yagyuu."
常闇斎"Yes."
Kageaki"I do not care whether you live or die."
常闇斎"..."

ja.html:
景明 「今度はお前か」
茶々丸 「うー」
常闇斎 「ここはどうか、私めにお任せを」
茶々丸 「……常闇？」
常闇斎 「実は元々、そのつもりでおりました」
景明 「お前とて暇を持て余す身ではなかろう」
常闇斎 「私の職務など、代理の務まる者は幾らでも おります」
景明 「それは俺も同じだ。 　俺の方が面倒もない」
常闇斎 「しかし適材適所と申しましょう。 　貴方様は潜入工作の専門家ではあられない」
景明 「……」
常闇斎 「この常闇は足利家の裏方、柳生一門の長。 　敵の陣中に潜り込むなど、日常茶飯のこと でございます」
茶々丸 「常闇……頼める？」
常闇斎 「緑龍会のため。 　我が信仰のため」
常闇斎 「必ずやご期待に沿いましょう」
茶々丸 「うん……」
景明 「……」
常闇斎 「湊斗様。 　いみじくも堀越中将様が申された通り―― 企み事とはなかなか思うように運ばぬもの」
常闇斎 「更にこの上、予期せぬ事態があるやもしれ ませぬ。 　貴方様は堀越中将様の傍らへお残りになり、 異変に備えて下さりませ」
常闇斎 「常闇、伏してお願い申し上げます」
景明 「……わかった」
景明 「柳生常闇斎」
常闇斎 「はい」
景明 「俺はお前が生きようが死のうが構わん」
常闇斎 「……」

Kageaki"But do not die pointlessly."
Kageaki"Somehow... I feel I could not permit that..."
常闇斎"————"
常闇斎"Understood. But do not worry..."
常闇斎"My fate awaits where I am going. Such is my feeling."
Kageaki"Fate?"
常闇斎"Yes."
常闇斎"Probably yours also, Minato sir, though you remain here."
Kageaki"..."
常闇斎"...Forgive me. I have spoken like a prophet."
常闇斎"Nonsense to trouble your ears."
Chachamaru"Jouan..."
常闇斎"I take my leave."
